src:
CLD
MOV     AH, 1Ah          ; DOS: our own DTA, not the command tail
MOV     DX, OFFSET DTA1
INT     21h
MOV     AH, 4Eh          ; DOS: find the first match
MOV     DX, OFFSET PAT1  ; "*.*"
MOV     CX, 10h          ; files and directories
INT     21h
NEXT1:
JC      DONE1            ; CF = 1: no (more) entries
MOV     SI, OFFSET DTA1+1Eh ; the name, ending with 0
MOV     BX, 13           ; the column is 13 wide
NAME1:
LODSB
OR      AL, AL
JZ      PAD1
MOV     DL, AL
MOV     AH, 02h
INT     21h
DEC     BX
JMP     NAME1
PAD1:
MOV     DL, " "          ; spaces to the next column
MOV     AH, 02h
INT     21h
DEC     BX
JNZ     PAD1
TEST    BYTE PTR DTA1+15h, 10h ; the attribute: a directory?
JZ      SIZE1
MOV     DX, OFFSET DIRM1
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
JMP     EOL1
SIZE1:
MOV     AX, WORD PTR DTA1+1Ah ; the size, low word
MOV     DX, WORD PTR DTA1+1Ch ; and high word
CALL    PDEC32
EOL1:
MOV     DX, OFFSET CRLF
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
MOV     AH, 4Fh          ; DOS: the next match, same DTA
INT     21h
JMP     NEXT1
DONE1:

PAT1    DB      "*.*", 0
DIRM1   DB      "<DIR>$"
DTA1    DB      43 DUP(0)
CRLF    DB      13, 10, "$"
PDEC32  PROC    NEAR     ; print DX:AX in decimal (changes AX BX CX DX DI)
MOV     BX, 10
XOR     CX, CX
PDEC32A:
PUSH    AX               ; DX:AX / 10 in two steps:
MOV     AX, DX
XOR     DX, DX
DIV     BX               ; the high word first
MOV     DI, AX           ; the high word of the quotient
POP     AX
DIV     BX               ; then remainder:low word
PUSH    DX               ; a digit
INC     CX
MOV     DX, DI           ; DX:AX = the quotient
OR      DI, AX
JNZ     PDEC32A
PDEC32B:
POP     DX
ADD     DL, "0"
MOV     AH, 02h
INT     21h
LOOP    PDEC32B
RET
PDEC32  ENDP
